steps.name: precheck-host
command: LOAD 'ecaz'; SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version, ecaz_build_profile() AS ecaz_build_profile, current_setting('ec_spire.nprobe') AS session_nprobe, current_setting('ec_spire.rerank_width') AS session_rerank_width, current_setting('ec_spire.adaptive_nprobe') AS adaptive_nprobe;
